steps.text: Rex wants to know what Galactopia needs. Ask around town!
checklist: Ask Pip (out to see the lamps in the evening)

steps.text: Tell Rex what everyone said. He's at the Town Hall in the daytime.
Hang Rex's VOTE REX posters around town.

wait.text: Rex is still painting the posters. Come back tomorrow!

checklist: The signpost west of the Market
The signpost by the Homes gate
The noticeboard in the Market Square

steps.text: Rex is giving a speech at the Market Square fountain this evening (5 to 9 PM). Go cheer him on!
Take Rex's ideas to Mr. Palmer, the mayor. Knock on his office window at the Town Hall in the daytime.

wait.text: Mr. Palmer has gone home for the day. Try tomorrow!

steps.text: Tell Rex what Mr. Palmer said.

reward.message: Rex gave you his VOTE REX sash! (And he's Future Mayor Rex now.)
